h: The Private Gift of the Additional Shabbos Soul

p: שֶׁנָּתַן לָהֶם הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לְיִשְׂרָאֵל
that HaKadosh Baruch Hu gave to Yisrael
'Between Me and the Children of Yisrael,' etc.
the idolaters should not be punished for it!
Shabbos itself He did make known to them;
its reward He did not make known to them.
its reward He also made known to them;
He did not make known to them,
as Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish said:
Now, since it said at first
what kind of answer is it
its reward and the additional soul,
"To know that I am Hashem Who sanctifies you,"
for the mitzvah of keeping Shabbos
they had already been commanded at Sinai,
and it is a mitzvah like all the mitzvos,
and is not included in the "good gift";
"For it is a sign between Me and you"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב פח, ב)
as is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 88b):
"A soul in which there is every perfection, etc.,
and therefore it is called Shabbos";
וְשָׁם כְּתִיב גַּם כֵּן (שְׁמוֹת לא, יז)
and there it is also written (Shemos 31:17):
"Between Me and the Children of Yisrael
Now, the fact that the Gemara called it
whereas according to the Gemara's exposition
it should have said an additional nefesh
this is based on what is said
it should have said 'woe, the body,'
since from it the nefesh was lost.
But the secret of the matter:
in a person there is a nefesh, etc.,
the whole day of Shabbos, etc."
And in the Tikkunim, in the Introduction:
on the days of Shabbosos and Yamim Tovim
which are the ten sefiros of Beriah;
He wears the ten bands of angels, etc.;
for in the ten sefiros of Atzilus,
He and His substance are one in them,
He and His life are one in them,
with the ten sefiros of Beriah, etc.
And in Pesach Eliyahu it says:
This is because the ten sefiros of Atzilus
for there He and His substance are one;
from the ten sefiros of Beriah.
And as is written in the Tikkunim,
that the nefesh is from Asiyah,
and there the majority is evil,
and its dwelling is in the liver,
which is the level of Esav
וְעַל זֶה אָמַר (בָּבָא בַתְרָא נח, ב)
and about this it says (Bava Basra 58b):
"At the head of all illnesses am I, blood"
for this is the husk of Esav,
the aspect of anger and jealousy,
And this is what is expounded in the Midrash
whose beginning is sweet and whose end is bitter.
And anger is the root of the yetzer hara,
all kinds of Gehinnom rule over him";
וְזֶה בְּרֵישׁ כָּל מַרְעִין אֲנָא דָּם
and this is "At the head of all illnesses am I, blood."
And the nefesh of a Jew
is from its minority that is good.
And the ruach is from Yetzirah,
where half is good and half is evil;
and the dwelling of the ruach is in the heart,
"a wise man's heart at his right
and a fool's heart at his left."
And the neshamah, whose dwelling is in the brain,
"The soul that You placed in me
goes from the heart to the brain,
and therefore its minority is evil.
And on a weekday, when He wears
which is the world of the angels,
not every person merits a neshamah,
And there is one who merits even from Atzilus,
אֲבָל לָאו כָּל אָדָם זוֹכֶה לָזֶה
but not every person merits this.
when He is clothed in the garments
that are the ten sefiros of Beriah,
and it says in Pesach Eliyahu:
from the side of the Throne,
which is the world of the Throne,
And within the additional neshamah of Shabbos, too,
for some merit more and more,
which is the aspect of the Name of Mah,
and therefore the Gemara called it:
HaKadosh Baruch Hu gives a person
the addition that was added to it
And as is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 204b):
And this is what the Gemara cited above says:
